date_text: Thu, Aug 27th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Aug 30th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Sailors Grave are sailing into Sydney and taking over the taps at Hotel Sweeney’s from Thursday 27 August. We’re pouring 11 Sailors Grave beers across the venue, bringing a massive slice of East Gippsland to the Sydney CBD — from crisp lager and coastal pales through to hazy IPA, stout, sour and some seriously interesting collaborations. ON TAP:- 🍋 Biru Shiso & Yuzu Gose – 5.2% Japanese Gose collab with Falo (Japan) 🌾 Five Ships – 5% Organic Spelt Lager 🍯 Honey Bush Braggot – 5.6% Honey Bush Banksia Red Ale collab with Nura Gunya 🦑 Squid vs Whale – 7% Oat Cream Hazy IPA 🐐 The Goat – 5% Modern Pale ⚓ Drowned Man – 4.8% Australian IPA 🌊 Sou’ East Draught – 4.8% 🐦 Sea Bird – 5.2% Coastal Hazy Pale with Saltbush 🔴 Southern Red Ale – 4.2% 🍋 Lemon Meringue Cream Sour – 3.5% 🌑 Lighthouse – 5% Oatmeal Stout Kicking off Thursday 27 August and pouring until they’re gone. Get into Sweeney’s, grab a schooner and work your way through one of the biggest Sailors Grave tap line-ups you’ll find in Sydney.
